instruction: Candid action photograph, medium close-up from a slightly high angle. Inside a minimalist martial arts dojo, the older man with thinning grey hair (R3) on the left and the clean-shaven young man (R2) on the right engage in a close judo grapple. The older man (R3), wearing a white gi, leans forward looking down, while the clean-shaven young man (R2), wearing a white gi with black shoulder stripes over a black undershirt, holds his arm and looks down with a concentrated expression. Soft, bright indoor lighting fills the space against a neutral grey background.
